name: Leveller
description: Adds an opt-in offline analysis bot for a small list of selected Geometry Dash levels.

enabled.name: Enable Leveller buttons
enabled.description: Show the PLAY and BOT buttons next to levels.

bot-enabled.name: Enable experimental BOT
bot-enabled.description: Run the local heuristic bot. It is limited to selected levels and normal mode.

analysis-strength.name: Analysis strength
analysis-strength.description: How far ahead the offline obstacle scan looks (1-5).

normal-mode-only.name: Normal Mode only
normal-mode-only.description: Keep BOT mode out of practice mode and avoid fake progress.
